name: Scroll Window Zoom Reveal
description: A GSAP ScrollTrigger image reveal for React: two offset windows cut into a wall show one photo; as you scroll they stretch level, merge into a single opening, and the wall zooms in until the photo fills the screen, then the heading turns in letter by letter and the text rises line by line. Clip-path polygons and transforms only.

props.name: image
props.description: The photo behind the windows (cover-fitted to the screen).

props.name: heading
props.description: The big heading that turns in once the photo is open.

props.name: text
props.description: The paragraph that rises in under it.

props.name: wall
props.description: Colour of the wall the windows are cut into.

props.name: zoom
props.description: How far the wall zooms in at the end (1.84 makes the window fill the screen).

props.name: scroller
props.description: The scrolling element, when it isn't the window.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the section (font for the heading, for one).
